chapterInfo.content:
21
Asɔfoɔ ho ahyɛdeɛ
1 # Hes 44.20-25 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo mu biara nngu ne ho fi efunu bi ho ne man mu, 2gye ne bogya a ɔbɛn no, ne na ne n’agya ne ne babanin ne ne babaa ne ne nuabarima, 3ne ne nuabaa a ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu a ɔbɛn no a ɔnnya nnyaa kunu, ɔno ho na ɔmma ne ho nkum. 4Ɔyɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ mu nipa titire nti, ɔnngu ne ho fi, nanso ɔnnhura ne ho. 5#Lew 19.27-28 Wɔnnyi wɔn mpampam na wɔnnwɛre wɔn bɔdwesɛ ano, na wɔmmmotabota wɔn honam mu.
6Wɔnyɛ kronkron mma wɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔnnhura wɔn Nyankopɔn din ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔde AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ, wɔn Nyankopɔn aduane no ba; enti wɔnyɛ kronkron.
7Wɔnnware ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ bi anaa deɛ ne ho ahura, nanso wɔnnware ɔbaa a ne kunu ako no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ kronkron ma ne Nyankopɔn. 8Na bu no kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ wo Nyankopɔn aduane na ɔde ba; ɔnyɛ onipa kronkron mma wo, ɛfiri sɛ kronkron ne me AWURADE a ɔyɛ mo kronkron no. 9Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ babaa firi aseɛ bɔ adwaman a, wahura n’agya ho, wɔmfa ogya nhye no.
10 # Eks 29.7; Lew 10.6 Na ne nuanom mu sɔfo panin a wɔahwie sra ngo agu n’atifi na wɔde ahyɛ ne nsam sɛ ɔnhyɛ ntadeɛ no, ɔmmpɛsɛ ne ti na ɔnnsunsuane ne ntadeɛ mu, 11na ɔnnkɔ efunu biara ho, n’agya ne ne na ho mpo ɔmmma ne ho nnkum. 12Na ɔmmfiri kronkronbea hɔ, na ɔnnhura ne Nyankopɔn kronkronbea ho, ɛfiri sɛ ne Nyankopɔn sra ngo no wɔ n’atifi: Mene AWURADE. 13Na ɔno deɛ, ɔbaabunu na ɔnwareɛ; 14okunafoɔ ne deɛ wɔako no ne deɛ ne ho ahura ne odwamamfoɔ deɛ, ɔnnware yeinom mu biara, na mmom ne man mu baabunu na ɔnwareɛ. 15Na ɔnnhura n’asefoɔ ho ne man mu: Na mene AWURADE a meyɛ no kronkron.
16Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 17Kasa kyerɛ Aaron sɛ: W’asefoɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu barima a ɔdi dɛm biara mmma mmmɛfa ne Nyankopɔn aduane no mmma; 18na obiara a ɔdi dɛm no mmmɛn, onifirani oo, apakye oo, hwento oo, deɛ ne honam biribi boro so oo, 19deɛ ne nan anaa ne nsa abu oo, 20afu oo, epira oo, deɛ ɛtɛ si n’ani soɔ oo, deɛ ɔyare ntwom oo, ogyatɔni oo, deɛ ne hwewa nnwoa abobɔ oo, 21Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron asefoɔ mu biara a ɔdi dɛm no nntwe mmpini mmmɛfa AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ no mma; ɛdɛm wɔ ne ho, ɔmmfa ne Nyankopɔn aduane no nntwe mmpini. 22Ne Nyankopɔn aduane, akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ɛne akronkronneɛ no deɛ, ɔnni bi. 23Ntwamutam no ho nko na ɔmmma, na afɔrebukyia no ho na ɔnntwe mmpini, ɛfiri sɛ ɛdɛm wɔ ne ho: Na wanhura m’akronkronneɛ no ho, ɛfiri sɛ mene AWURADE a meyɛ wɔn kronkron. 24Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa.

Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron mma asɔfoɔ no na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo mu biara nngu ne ho fi efunu bi ho ne man mu, gye ne bogya a ɔbɛn no, ne na ne n’agya ne ne babanin ne ne babaa ne ne nuabarima, ne ne nuabaa a ɔyɛ ɔbaabunu a ɔbɛn no a ɔnnya nnyaa kunu, ɔno ho na ɔmma ne ho nkum. Ɔyɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ mu nipa titire nti, ɔnngu ne ho fi, nanso ɔnnhura ne ho. Wɔnnyi wɔn mpampam na wɔnnwɛre wɔn bɔdwesɛ ano, na wɔmmmotabota wɔn honam mu.
Wɔnyɛ kronkron mma wɔn Nyankopɔn, na wɔnnhura wɔn Nyankopɔn din ho, ɛfiri sɛ wɔn na wɔde AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ, wɔn Nyankopɔn aduane no ba; enti wɔnyɛ kronkron.
Wɔnnware ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ bi anaa deɛ ne ho ahura, nanso wɔnnware ɔbaa a ne kunu ako no, ɛfiri sɛ ɔyɛ kronkron ma ne Nyankopɔn. Na bu no kronkron, ɛfiri sɛ wo Nyankopɔn aduane na ɔde ba; ɔnyɛ onipa kronkron mma wo, ɛfiri sɛ kronkron ne me AWURADE a ɔyɛ mo kronkron no. Na sɛ ɔsɔfoɔ babaa firi aseɛ bɔ adwaman a, wahura n’agya ho, wɔmfa ogya nhye no.
Na ne nuanom mu sɔfo panin a wɔahwie sra ngo agu n’atifi na wɔde ahyɛ ne nsam sɛ ɔnhyɛ ntadeɛ no, ɔmmpɛsɛ ne ti na ɔnnsunsuane ne ntadeɛ mu, na ɔnnkɔ efunu biara ho, n’agya ne ne na ho mpo ɔmmma ne ho nnkum. Na ɔmmfiri kronkronbea hɔ, na ɔnnhura ne Nyankopɔn kronkronbea ho, ɛfiri sɛ ne Nyankopɔn sra ngo no wɔ n’atifi: Mene AWURADE. Na ɔno deɛ, ɔbaabunu na ɔnwareɛ; okunafoɔ ne deɛ wɔako no ne deɛ ne ho ahura ne odwamamfoɔ deɛ, ɔnnware yeinom mu biara, na mmom ne man mu baabunu na ɔnwareɛ. Na ɔnnhura n’asefoɔ ho ne man mu: Na mene AWURADE a meyɛ no kronkron.
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Aaron sɛ: W’asefoɔ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu barima a ɔdi dɛm biara mmma mmmɛfa ne Nyankopɔn aduane no mmma; na obiara a ɔdi dɛm no mmmɛn, onifirani oo, apakye oo, hwento oo, deɛ ne honam biribi boro so oo, deɛ ne nan anaa ne nsa abu oo, afu oo, epira oo, deɛ ɛtɛ si n’ani soɔ oo, deɛ ɔyare ntwom oo, ogyatɔni oo, deɛ ne hwewa nnwoa abobɔ oo, Ɔsɔfoɔ Aaron asefoɔ mu biara a ɔdi dɛm no nntwe mmpini mmmɛfa AWURADE gya afɔdeɛ no mma; ɛdɛm wɔ ne ho, ɔmmfa ne Nyankopɔn aduane no nntwe mmpini. Ne Nyankopɔn aduane, akronkronneɛ mu ade kronkron ɛne akronkronneɛ no deɛ, ɔnni bi. Ntwamutam no ho nko na ɔmmma, na afɔrebukyia no ho na ɔnntwe mmpini, ɛfiri sɛ ɛdɛm wɔ ne ho: Na wanhura m’akronkronneɛ no ho, ɛfiri sɛ mene AWURADE a meyɛ wɔn kronkron. Na Mose ka kyerɛɛ Aaron ne ne mma ne Israelfoɔ nyinaa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
